label: UniFi XG Application Server (UAS-XG)
description: Ubiquiti UniFi XG Application Server - 1U rackmount Ubuntu host running the UniFi Network and UniFi Video controllers: two 10GBase-T RJ45 LAN ports (1G/10G), a dedicated 1GBase-T IPMI management port, Intel Xeon D-1521 with 32 GB DDR4, two 3.5-inch HDD bays, 150 W maximum (60 W typical) from a universal 100-240 VAC input. Discontinued.
notes: The page spells out the three sockets as '(2) 10GBase-T 1G/10G RJ45 LAN ports - 1GBase-T Dedicated IPMI Management Port', which is why the 10G ports carry a 100M/1G/10G ladder rather than a bare 10G: they are 10GBase-T and fall back, unlike the SFP+ cages elsewhere in this catalogue. The IPMI port is deliberately separate and unbridged - it is out-of-band management, so a lab that bridges it into the LAN is modelling a different box. The 150 W is a maximum with 60 W typical from a universal AC input: no PoE in or out on any port. The product is discontinued, which does not change its wiring but does mean the successor in a new design is the UDM.
